anomalies.description: A soldier is kneeling over a prone, seemingly incapacitated man on the ground, gripping his throat/neck area with both hands in a choking or suffocating manner; the victim shows no resistance and appears helpless.
A soldier in the background raises a rifle to his shoulder and fires; muzzle flash is visible at f10 (5.0s), and the recoil motion is evident across frames f9–f11.
Two soldiers engage in close-quarters physical combat: one lunges forward while the other ducks and raises arms defensively; contact and struggle are implied by posture and motion blur in f12–f15.
A soldier (right) is visually confirmed firing a pistol at another soldier (left), with muzzle flash and recoil visible in frames f4–f6.

A sudden dust/debris cloud erupts near the foreground soldier in f15, consistent with a nearby small explosion or impact blast; no sustained fire or vehicle involved.; A sudden dust/debris cloud erupts around the left soldier immediately after the shot, consistent with an impact explosion or near-miss blast; visible as rapid expansion of particulate matter in frames f7–f9.
A sudden blast occurs in the background, generating a large dust cloud and debris displacement visible from f0 to f3; the soldier reacts by flinching and turning.
A second explosion erupts near the soldier’s left side (viewer’s right), producing a sharp burst of dust and debris seen in f7–f9; the soldier recoils and raises his arm.
A third explosion occurs close to the soldier’s position, with a visible dust plume and structural collapse at f12–f15; the soldier is thrown backward against a wall and stumbles.

A visible muzzle flash erupts from the soldier's pistol as he fires while taking cover against a wall.; A second visible muzzle flash occurs from the same pistol, indicating a subsequent shot fired in rapid succession.
